objective: Determine whether the sealed LayerCake release already exposes a canonical interface capable of accepting an independently validated external English core artifact without retraining or mutating that artifact.
scope: LayerCake host interfaces and preserved LayerCake evidence only
questions: Is the interface canonical and content-addressed?
Can it carry persistent self-causal generation state?
Has it preserved useful autonomous behavior rather than teacher-forced fit alone?
Can an unchanged signed artifact execute on CPU and CUDA without receiver learning?
Is it certified as the LayerCake English core rather than only a selected domain cake?
decision_rule: If no existing interface passes all five questions, record a host-interface scope gap without invalidating the sealed LayerCake release or blaming external extraction. The next repair must be a separately versioned direct neural core artifact interface and must independently recertify all affected behavior and performance.
claim_boundary: This audit may identify an interface scope gap. It cannot claim a model defect, external acquisition failure, quality result, new host feature, or inherited certification.
